zweck: Diagram from a short JSON specification (SeeCode): architecture, flow with decisions, states, ER model, database schema, UML classes, swimlanes, sequence, tree and org chart. The agent only sets nodes and edges (row/column); the template computes sizes, paths and colours. Hovering or tabbing onto an element highlights it with its connections, and there is a text list as well. No fetches from outside.

type.description: Art des Diagramms; Graph-Arten brauchen nodes (+ edges), medallion/dp-integration stages, sequence participants + messages, tree/org-chart root

dir.description: Main direction: LR (left to right) or TB (top to bottom)

nodes.description: Graph kinds: [{id, label, sub?, tag?, kind?, focal?, shape?, row, col, group?, icon?, status?, fields?}], kind: backend|focal|store|external|input|optional|security|muted

edges.description: [from, to, label?, kind?] or {from, to, label?, kind?}; kind: default|primary|link|async|return|muted (ER/UML: one-many, extends, composes ...)

groups.description: [{id, label, style?: dashed}], nodes belong to it via group

messages.description: sequence: [from, to, text?, kind?] with kind sync|reply|async|self|primary

fragments.description: sequence: [{kind: alt|opt|loop|par|critical|break, from, to, label?, else?}] over message numbers

budget.description: How many nodes without a warning: balanced 9, faithful 24

legend.description: false hides the legend, true forces it

beispiel.ueberschrift: How a view gets into the chat
beispiel.text: The agent only gives the specification; Hub, store and app do the rest.
